Q3 2026 closed with $720,000 in revenue against $464,000 in spend, for an operating surplus of $256,000. The Q3 delivery project kicked off October 5 and, following the standard phase sequence (Discovery, Build, QA, Release) and accounting for the October 12 company holiday, is on track to launch October 23.
